name: EPIC 211964709
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 10.4 solar radii and 1.09 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 211964709 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.400143 (16th-84th percentiles 10.117025-10.721992), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,647 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.09 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 5,178 K at its surface.
